findings.evidence: Draft: `The [PR's tests](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/2007) compare replay costs across one and eight parked rows and check that deferred rows remain retryable.` The captured PR-body/fact-check readback states regression tests comparing eight parked rows to one, 681 engine tests passed and five skipped, `just fast-ci` passed, deferred-sweep ingest, and a shared per-group past-peel cache — not a test described as proving deferred rows remain retryable.
findings.recommendation: Quote only the captured test facts (eight-versus-one parked-row comparison, 681 passed / 5 skipped, optionally `just fast-ci`) and describe the new path as deferred-sweep ingest plus a shared per-group past-peel cache invalidated on canonical changes.
findings.title: MDK #2007 attributes a retryability test not present in the supplied PR-body facts

findings.evidence: Signed notes at https://primal.net/e/c5c5ad0eba413e18c10e3cd2be607e550ac818a8abaf97ccbf8fa242fbaff15f make Nostr optional (`Find more games on Nostr (kind 7529), downloaded from Blossom and verified byte for byte`) while table play is local Bluetooth/Wi-Fi with no account. The same artifact has empty `app_repository` and `app_url`, and states mesh testing in simulation/emulators only. The memo INCLUDE reason is that distinctive distribution path, not gameplay-over-Nostr. The draft correctly says `Nostr is used to discover and deliver optional games; the actual table session runs locally` and `not yet at real multi-phone tables`.
findings.recommendation: Keep the INCLUDE decision. Treat Top Story as a first-appearance spotlight only, on par with napplet.soy/RelayKit/Threshold Sessions, and do not imply a protocol milestone. Prefer Tagged Releases if the lede cannot make room.
findings.title: Optional kind-7529/Blossom path meets INCLUDE/8/10; Top Story is the ceiling of that case

findings.title: Final specs family and remaining gates stay separate from this cold read

summary: MDK #2007 describes only the merged library fix, correctly separates tagged 0.10.4 from later master work, and does not invent end-user latency or deployed-client behavior. Table Mesh 0.1.0 correctly reports Bluetooth/Wi-Fi local play, bundled Mensch ärgere Dich nicht plus bots, kind-7529/Blossom fetch with byte-hash verification, emulator-only mesh testing, and that Nostr does not carry table moves. The optional kind-7529/Blossom path is narrowly enough for INCLUDE/8/10, but inserting Table Mesh as a Top Story without updating the YAML description or weekly lede is a major continuity defect, so these two story decisions/wording cannot PASS on this snapshot. This verdict does not approve publication or the final ten-family sweep; final source, PR-head, CI, deployment, signing, and relay gates remain separate, and the unreviewed specs family is not assumed clean.
